messages:
marta: Heads-up — Sunflower Health private VPC cutover scheduled this Friday 03:00-04:00 UTC. Can folks confirm ops coverage and rollback readiness?

jason: I can be on the window. planning to run the rollout and smoke. queue me for 02:45 UTC to start prep.

li: I'll be on standby for config/route changes. Are we doing canary first or full swap?

sam: Canary for the first 10 minutes, then cut traffic if all green. Watch list: auth, inference endpoints, and KV cache.

katie_ops: @marta I have the runbook updated with the Sunflower steps. small note — their telemetry agent needs a restart after deploy. I added the command block.

marta: thanks katie. paste of the smoke steps for visibility:
```
# smoke checklist (run after deploy)
1) curl -sS https://sunflower.example/internal/health | jq .status  # expect OK
2) curl -sS https://sunflower.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' | jq .output
3) check redis keys prefix sunflower:cache exists
4) tail /var/log/redwood/inference.log for 2m, confirm no OOM or KV errors
```

jason: deploying image sha: ab12c3f — health patch + KV cache fix. CR approvals done (li + sam).

li: ack on approvals. DB migrations?

jason: no schema changes, just config toggle. rollback is to flip the toggle and redeploy previous image sha: 9f8e7d6. I tested locally.

katie_ops: I've delegated incident oncall to @sam for the window. If we hit 5xxs > 2% for 3m, roll back.

sam: got it. I'll run synthetic traffic during canary and monitor latency + errors.

deploy-bot: scheduled deployment job #sunflower-547 at 2026-03-20T03:00:00Z by jason. Canary window = 10m. Notifications: #eng-platform, pager oncall.

marta: last checks — anyone need a dry-run earlier this week?

li: a quick dry-run tomorrow 02:45 UTC would be useful to validate the restart command and RB toggle. 15min.

jason: I can do that. booking 02:45 tomorrow, will post the test job id.

marta: perfect. I'll circulate the runbook link and escalation matrix. Thanks all :thumbsup:
